en.t: Young student, you are going to Tokyo, aren't you?

units.source_text: 我们信赖您，拜托您把这位老婆子带到东京，行不行啊？

en.t: We trust you, so could we ask you to take this old woman to Tokyo?

units.source_text: 她是个可怜巴巴的老婆子。

en.t: She is a terribly pitiable old woman.

units.source_text: 她儿子早先在莲台寺的银矿上干活，这次染上了流感，儿子、儿媳都死掉了。

en.t: Her son used to work at the silver mine in Rendaiji, but this time he caught influenza, and both her son and daughter-in-law died.

units.source_text: 留下三个这么小不丁点的孙子。

en.t: They left behind three tiny grandchildren as small as this.

units.source_text: 无可奈何，俺们商量，还是让她回老家。

en.t: With no other choice, we talked it over and decided after all to send her back to her hometown.

units.source_text: 老婆子什么也不清楚，到了灵岸岛，请您送她乘上开往上野站的电车就行了。

en.t: The old woman does not understand anything, so when you get to Reiganjima, please just put her on the streetcar bound for Ueno Station.
We are sorry to trouble you.
We bow to you in thanks and supplication.

units.source_text: 唉，您看到她这般处境，也会感到可怜的吧。”

en.t: Ah, once you see the state she is in, you will feel sorry for her too, won't you?
